The Diamond Villa

A unique villa in Corfu Island which guests can enjoy a lovely and luxurious hospitality. The elegant interior decoration fits into a very modern and functional home. Its location is incredibly convenient as very close to villa there are big supermarkets, taverns, restaurants, tourist shops, a car rental office, a taxi stop and a bus stop with frequent local itineraries towards the city of Corfu. Layout Exterior area The modern, outdoor private entrance and the exterior stone wall combined with the exterior trees offer the visitor a full privacy and security to enjoy peaceful and relaxing vacations. The outdoor area can give you endless hours of relaxation in the privet heated pool around which there are comfortable sunbeds, poufs, a hammock, a large corner sofa and a very comfortable bed. There is also an outdoor shower in the same area. In the barbecue you can enjoy your meal near the pool. The kitchen is fully equipped, (dishes, cutlery, glasses etc.) and a large dining room. Finally, our younger guests can play comfortably on our beautiful fenced playground…

Customer Service

The owners reside at as short distance from the villas, and personally attend to the rental of the villas as well as the customer service ensuring that their guests’ stay is as comfortable and pleasant as possible. Newly built contemporary villa, with a minimalist design, build with of the best materials and equipped for all your needs to enjoy your beautiful vacation.

More Information

Diamond villa is an ideal choice for those looking for tranquility and relaxation for their holidays. Newly built in 2020 with modern design and exquisite decor on a hill in Kato Spileo, Mesongi. Suitable for up to 10 people, ideal for large families and groups of visitors. One building that consists of 2 bathrooms, private pool with garden view, fully equipped kitchen, smart TVs, WiFi, AC, walking distance to Moraitika and Mesongi Village and beach.

On the ground floor there is the spacious lounge with stylish modern furniture and atmosphere, Smart led TV, dining room and fully equipped modern kitchen. The large glass window offers plenty of light and coolness. On the same floor exist 1 large bedroom and a bathroom. You can choose between the three bedrooms with super king doubles and spacious wardrobes, each equipped with TV and one with 2 single beds. Also, the first floor has a kitchen and 2 bathrooms. The terrace of the bedrooms offers you breathtaking view and the possibility of being isolated from the rest of the company when you wish.

This holiday villa provides you with a space you’ll want to spend time in. It is spacious, modern, and welcoming; playful and proactive; quiet, and yet close to all resort’s amenities. Extensive Corfu villa amenities and services make all the difference. Whether you are staying in or stepping out there is always something to do and plenty to enjoy. Each luxury amenity and service were carefully chosen to transform your getaway and vacations into something truly extraordinary.
